subject: POC kickoff: hybrid vs onsite workshop — scheduling & visitor access
messages:
From: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@finserve.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan White <alan.white@finserve.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: POC kickoff — timeframe & logistics

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the demo last week. We'd like to lock in a two-day POC kickoff and working session the week of 2/23 to review prompts, routing rules, and run some load tests. A quick note on logistics: FinServe prefers onsite for the first day (stakeholder walkthrough) and virtual for the second (hands-on prompt tuning), but we can be flexible.

Questions for you so we can coordinate with our facilities/security teams:
- Do you need a pass for visitor badges or pre-registration?
- Will the session be recorded? If so, we need to confirm archive & access controls.
- Any special AV requirements (HDMI adapters, laptop staging)?

Would love a couple of proposed times for 2/24 and 2/25 (half-day / full-day options). I've looped in Alan for facilities and Marissa from Redwood for the technical agenda.

Thanks,
Ruth
Ruth Chang
Head of Platform Integrations — FinServe

(Attachment: high-level goals.pdf)

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@finserve.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai, Alan White <alan.white@finserve.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — timeframe & logistics

Ruth —

Appreciate the context. We're excited to run this with FinServe. Quick responses inline and a couple of options below.

Visitor access: we can provide a signed visitor list in advance and bring two photo IDs per attendee. If you prefer pre-registered badges, send the name/email/phone for each Redwood attendee and we will populate the form.

Recording: Redwood is fine with recording for internal review. If FinServe needs the recording to stay behind the firewall, we can upload to your secure Drive link instead of our shared account. Please confirm retention policy.

AV: we'll bring a Mac & USB-C -> HDMI adapter; please confirm whether the room has HDMI or AirPlay.

Proposed schedule options (all times ET):
- Option A: Wed 2026-02-24, 09:00–17:00 (onsite half-day kickoff + afternoon hands-on) and Thu 2026-02-25, 10:00–13:00 (virtual deep-dive).
- Option B: Wed 2026-02-24, 13:00–17:00 (onsite walkthrough) and Thu 2026-02-25, 09:00–17:00 (virtual full-day hands-on & load tests).

Agenda highlights I'm proposing:
- Day 1 (onsite): executive kickoff, prompt review, routing policies, security checklist.
- Day 2 (virtual): prompt tuning, quantization/latency tradeoffs, sustained load tests + failure injection.

Marissa, can you confirm whether 2/25 we should schedule dedicated GPU-backed load slots and prepare the test prompt set? Dev, can you bring the KV cache/control plan and any scripts we should run for sustained load?

I'll attach a draft agenda and visitor form for facilities. Once FinServe confirms Option A or B (and attendees), I'll send calendar invites and a secure recording plan.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf; Visitor_Access_Form.docx)

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@finserve.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:34:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — timeframe & logistics

Looping in technical details from my side.

Load testing: we have two profiles ready — 'steady' (300 req/min, 1–2s p95 on x1) and 'spike' (1k req/min bursts). For an onsite demo, I'd recommend running the steady profile during the hands-on and the spike profile during a 30–45m slot on day 2 (virtual) so we can observe routing fallback behavior. We'll need the list of prompt prefixes you want cached.

Screen sharing/recording: Fine to record. Note that if we record virtual screens while we run load tests, the recording may capture logs with token-level metrics. Recommend redaction or a secure Drive upload per Dylan's note.

Equipment: if we're onsite we should have a dedicated network drop for the test laptop (avoid guest Wi-Fi). If not available, we can run via a VPN tunnel but that may add ~50–100ms per request; call that out in results.

I'll prepare:
- load_scripts.zip (scripts to run spike/steady)
- prompt_set.csv (50 prompts for tuning)
- kv_cache_snapshot.json (sample)

Will upload to the shared Drive once Dylan confirms calendar and drive permissions.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Also, please confirm number of Redwood on-site staff (so we can prepare visitor badges).

Thanks,
